relationships.subject: TIM3
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, TIM3 negatively regulates glycolysis, thereby suppressing NOD-, LRR-, and pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome activation

relationships.subject: glycolysis
relationships.evidence_quote: both glycolysis and the glycolysis-associated NLRP3 inflammasome are essential for TIM3-mediated neuropathic pain development

relationships.subject: TIM3
relationships.evidence_quote: TIM3 inhibits nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-κB) activation by downregulating glycolysis

key_findings: TIM3 is upregulated after CCI and limits neuropathic pain and microglial neuroinflammation.
TIM3 suppresses glycolysis-driven NLRP3 inflammasome activation and NF-kB activation in microglia.
